_comment: The client/ commit this demo sandbox was built against. tools/portal-sync.mjs compares it to the live head of `branch` and fails when the demo falls behind. Update it in the same commit that updates the sandbox — or, if client/ moved without changing anything a client can see, in the same commit as a note saying which commits were reviewed and why they do not affect the sandbox. Never re-pin without doing one of those two things.

reviewed.note: Pinned to client/light-reskin, which is now the light re-skin rebased onto development (10a3bc2), so it contains everything development has in client/. The sandbox was rebuilt for the one client-facing addition from that rebase: 93607c9's ThemeColorsPanel on My website. 93607c9's other half, defining pages during onboarding, runs before a site is generated and Rosa's site already exists, so the sandbox has no onboarding to show it in. 5bca2cf and d8ac01a are the development-only rollback panel; 676076d is BACKLOG.md. The re-skin is still unmerged: once it lands on development, set branch back to development and pin the merge commit.
